attributes.name: Pauldrons of Unflinching Fortitude
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add your number of mythic charges to your non-combat Dexterity, Wisdom, Constitution, or Fortitude check.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, buy it instead.

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
